name: Glaston Oyj Abp
summary: Glaston Oyj Abp manufactures and sells glass processing machinery worldwide. It operates through two segments, Glaston and Bystronic Glass. The company offers flat tempering and laminating, bending and tempering, and bending and laminating machines. It is also involved in the maintenance and servicing of glass processing machines. In addition, the company provides remote monitoring and fault analysis, consulting and engineering, and machine upgrade and modernization services, as well as spare parts. Its products and services are primarily used in the architectural, appliance, automotive, and solar energy industries. The company was formerly known as O/y Kyro A/b and changed its name to Glaston Oyj Abp in June 2007. Glaston Oyj Abp was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
